text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning.

Your project caught my attention because you’re looking for someone who can help build and integrate GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion into an existing brand, not just as a one-off implementation, but as a long-term technical partner. That’s the kind of work I enjoy: turning model capabilities into something practical, reliable, and aligned with a business use case.

One relevant project I’d point to is a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant in Python using the OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context when needed. The result was 43% of conversations resolved without an agent, and the experience reached a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That project strengthened my approach to integrating AI into existing workflows, keeping the user experience smooth while making the underlying system dependable.

For your Stable Diffusion + GPT-3 work, I can help with the integration side as well as the practical implementation details: shaping prompts and workflows, connecting models to existing product logic, and building an architecture that can support future projects as well. If the first project is about adding AI capabilities to an established brand, I’d focus on making sure the output feels consistent with that brand while remaining flexible enough to evolve.

I’m especially interested in longer-term collaboration because that usually leads to better technical decisions and cleaner integrations over time. If useful, I can help you think through both the initial rollout and how the same stack could be extended across your other projects.

What kind of existing brand or product are you planning to integrate GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion into first?
